chiara.label: Chiara's Dolphin
chiara.text: A grey-blue plush dolphin with a navy ribbon. It has more sea miles than you.

lola.label: Lola's Kangaroo
lola.text: A sandy plush kangaroo with a joey in its pouch and a shell on a string. All the way from Brisbane.

megan.label: Megan's Black Puma
megan.text: A sleek black plush puma with a gold anchor pin. Every predator needs a mascot.

lea.label: Lea's Clownfish
lea.text: An orange and white plush clownfish with a big grin. Clownfish never leave their anemone.

rosi.label: Little Unit-01
rosi.text: A white plush robot shaped like a tiny generator, sewn on a night shift. It doesn't explode. Probably.

toto.label: Totò's Raccoon
toto.text: A very round plush raccoon with a bandit mask, a gold chain and flip-flops. It was adopted.

holm.label: Holm's Polar Bear
holm.text: A white plush polar bear in a captain's cap. Thirty years of watches, since Tromsø.

yamamoto.label: Yamamoto's Turtle
yamamoto.text: A green plush sea turtle with tiny sunglasses. Slow, but it sees everything.

petru.label: Petru's Octopus
petru.text: A coral red plush octopus in a knitted fisherman's cap. Eight arms, and it catches what comes.

nonna.label: Nonna's Hen
nonna.text: A plump plush hen in a checked apron. She watches the kitchen, and now she watches you.

isabelle.label: Isabelle's Sheep
isabelle.text: A happy white plush sheep with lavender stitched on its chest. Lavender is for healing.

alva.label: Alva's Little Bull
alva.text: A black plush bull calf with a red carnation from Sevilla behind one horn.

yasin.label: Yasin's Falcon
yasin.text: A round, fluffy plush falcon with a tiny gold chain. Limited edition. Only one exists.

frederico.label: Frederico's Black Lion
frederico.text: A black plush lion cub with golden eyes and no collar. Nobody gets a collar anymore.

jana.label: Not Strudel
jana.text: A white plush cat with blue eyes and a red and white scarf. It is definitely not Strudel.

siri.label: Selma the Seal
siri.text: A white plush baby seal in a knitted Nordic hat. Been to every shoot, never on camera.

sophia.label: Sophia's Owl
sophia.text: A brown plush owl with round glasses and a tiny book. It sees everything and says nothing.

elsa.label: Elsa's Shepherd
elsa.text: A plush German shepherd in a navy police cap. It has stared down three smugglers this year.

maxwell.label: The Champion
maxwell.text: A muscular plush gorilla with sunglasses and a gold champion belt. It never skips breakfast.

casanova.label: The Mayor's Flamingo
casanova.text: A pink plush flamingo in a ruffled flamenco dress. She never loses her composure.

mazzera.label: A Mazzera's Hunting Charm
mazzera.text: A crescent of two boar tusks, raven feathers and a moonstone, bound with red thread. A dream hunter wore it, long before Dumenica.
